restrictions.title: Minimum Order Value Restriction
restrictions.body: Apply multiple restrictions to a single product page, including per product and per variant restrictions. Set maximum order quantities, enforce minimums per color or size, and prevent overselling effortlessly.
restrictions.highlightText: Max 5 T-shirts total, min 3 red. Customers must order 3 red + at least 2 of any other color.

increments.title: Add Incremental Quantity for Product Variants
